jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager
jobs.description: About myTomorrows myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options. We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem. We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection. With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business. Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. The Opportunity: Senior Engineering Manager As an Engineering Manager at myTomorrows, you will lead Backend, Frontend, Full Stack and QA engineers building the platforms that help patients find their treatment options. Our Expanded Access Program (EAP) platform and Clinical Trials (CT) platform connect patients and healthcare professionals with treatments in development and give our BioPharma Partners the tools to run their programs and trials. You’ll shape how these platforms grow, building a high-performing team that ships well-designed, scalable, secure and compliant software, and delivers it on time. You won’t do it alone. jobs.title: Scientist - Phenotypic Data
jobs.description: Location: Oxford, London or RTP (Hybrid) The Mission: Why We Exist Genomics is a science-led transatlantic TechBio combining large-scale genetic and health data with proprietary analytics to accelerate drug discovery and advance predictive, preventative healthcare. We are united by a single vision to help people live longer healthier lives, using the power of genomics. Genomics aims to help people live longer, healthier lives in two ways: super-charging drug discovery and development for novel treatments with our AI-enabled advanced genetic analytics platform, and by helping people understand their personal risk of common chronic diseases through polygenic risk scores - giving doctors and health systems the chance to get the right people into the right prevention, screening and treatment programmes at the right time. Role Purpose Genetic analyses are only as good as the definitions of disease they’re built on. Get the phenotype wrong and everything downstream wobbles. As a Scientist in Clinical Informatics, you’ll define, curate and validate phenotypes from electronic health records and other clinical data. That gives our genetic discovery work and risk tools foundations that are accurate, clinically meaningful and reproducible. You’ll join the Life Sciences team, which tackles challenges across the therapeutic development cycle, from target discovery to patient stratification and finding new opportunities for existing drugs. This is an early-career role in a highly collaborative team. You’ll be supported to develop your own ownership of analyses, and you’ll see your work reused across projects. jobs.title: Scientist - Functional Genomics
jobs.description: Location: Oxford, London or RTP (Hybrid) The Mission: Why We Exist Genomics is a science-led transatlantic TechBio combining large-scale genetic and health data with proprietary analytics to accelerate drug discovery and advance predictive, preventative healthcare. We are united by a single vision to help people live longer healthier lives, using the power of genomics. Genomics aims to help people live longer, healthier lives in two ways: super-charging drug discovery and development for novel treatments with our AI-enabled advanced genetic analytics platform, and by helping people understand their personal risk of common chronic diseases through polygenic risk scores - giving doctors and health systems the chance to get the right people into the right prevention, screening and treatment programmes at the right time. Role Purpose A genetic association tells you where in the genome a disease signal lives. It doesn’t tell you why . That’s the question you’ll answer. As a Scientist in Functional Genomics, you’ll turn genetic associations into biological understanding. You’ll work out which genes and variants are likely to be causal, and through which cell types, tissues and pathways they act. The Life Sciences team then uses that to triage targets and build the evidence behind a development programme. Your work will span the therapeutic development cycle, from target discovery to patient stratification and finding new uses for existing drugs. This is an early-career role in a highly collaborative team. You’ll have the support to develop and run innovative, rigorous science, and the visibility to share it with internal and external stakeholders. Tens of thousands of positions remain unfilled each year, and demographic shifts are only making things worse. jobs.title: Director/Senior Director, EMEA Health Economics and Outcomes Research (HEOR) Leader
jobs.description: Scholar Rock is delivering muscle-targeted breakthroughs to transform the treatment of spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) and other rare neuromuscular diseases where muscle atrophy remains a critical unmet need. As a global leader in myostatin biology, a field focused on proteins that regulate muscle mass, the biopharmaceutical company is named for the visual resemblance of a scholar rock to protein structures. Our commitment to unlock fundamentally different treatment approaches is powered by broad application of a proprietary platform, which has developed novel monoclonal antibodies to modulate protein growth factors with extraordinary selectivity. Scholar Rock works every day to create new possibilities for patients through its highly innovative anti-myostatin program, including opportunities in additional rare neuromuscular diseases. Learn more about our neuromuscular franchise at ScholarRock.com and follow @ScholarRock on X and on LinkedIn. Summary of Position: The Director/Senior Director, EMEA Health Economics and Outcomes Research (HEOR) Leader, reporting to the Vice President Global Medical Affairs, will lead the development and execution of the go-to market strategy and deliverables to support value of apitegromab as well as the clinical stage Scholar Rock portfolio, in close partnership with the cross-functional matrix team. This individual will serve as the strategic leader and subject matter expert for EMEA HEOR, responsible for country-level budget impact and cost-effectiveness model adaptations, evidence generation plans, and value communications required to support the national health technology assessment (HTA), payer dossiers, EU Joint Clinical Assessment (JCA), and reimbursement negotiations of Scholar Rock treatments. The role requires strong strategic leadership and cross-functional collaboration with Medical Affairs, Market Access, Commercial, Clinical Development and the regional teams in EMEA to optimize access and reimbursement for patients world

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description: Senior Product Manager Own the complex product challenges behind the next generation of MedTech software. REMATIQ is building AI software that helps life sciences and medical device companies bring products to market faster, without compromising the quality, traceability and compliance their industry demands. We work with leading companies including Philips, Siemens Healthineers, B. Braun and Novartis, and have recently closed our Series A. We believe in the value of in-person collaboration and work in a hybrid setup, with the team coming together in our office in the heart of Berlin-Mitte typically four days per week . Now we're looking for a hands-on Senior Product Manager to take ownership of some of the most important and complex areas of our AI-native platform. The role This is a role for someone who loves product craft, enjoys solving difficult problems and wants substantial ownership over what gets built. You'll work closely with customers, engineers, designers and our founders to turn complex enterprise workflows into AI-native product experiences. You'll own the full product development cycle within your area: Customer insight → product ideas → prioritization → definition → engineering refinement → sprint execution → shipped product → learning. You'll be responsible not just for defining what to build, but for making good decisions, driving execution and ensuring the result actually solves the problem. This is a senior individual contributor role with real product ownership. We don't expect you to manage other PMs, but we do expect you to lead through your judgment, technical understanding and ability to get things done. What you'll do Own complex product areas end to end: Take responsibility for discovery, prioritization, definition, delivery and continuous improvement within your domain. We are addressing the challenges facing the research and development of novel compounds in Oncology and are dedicated to positively impacting the health and lives of patients around the world. The CDM works on multi-functional teams and supports clinical trial projects as a departmental subject matter expert (SME). We are seeking a temporary clinical data manager who can dedicate 20 hours a week to support ongoing study activities.
